get.summary: Retrieve Uttar Pradesh (UP) specific market data
get.description: Fetches interval market data for a given market type (DAM, RTM, GDAM) based on the specified date range.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: The market type to fetch data for.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Start date for the data fetch (YYYY-MM-DD). If no `endDate` is provided, fetches only for this day.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for the data fetch (YYYY-MM-DD).

400.description: Bad request (Invalid parameters or date range).
